business_summary.text: Shakti Pumps is a leading manufacturer of solar water pumps and related products, with a focus on the renewable energy sector. The company is expanding into adjacent businesses including solar rooftop systems, EV motors, and backward integration into solar modules and cells.

call_points.text: Order book of ₹1,500 Cr as on 7 May 2026, to be executed over the next two quarters.
0.5 GW module plant to commission by end-Q1FY27; 2.2 GW solar cell capacity targeted for March 2028.
Export margins are around 10% higher than domestic.
Solar rooftop business targeting 15% EBITDA margin; no revenue guidance yet.
EV motors and controllers: ₹70 Cr of ₹114 Cr capex invested; results expected in six months to one year.
Management declined to quantify margin recovery, saying it will update post-Q1FY27.
0.5 GW DCR module capacity expected operational by end of Q1FY27.
Order book stands at ₹1,500 Cr as on 7 May 2026, inclusive of GST.

2.2 GW solar cell capacity targeted for March 2028.
Solar rooftop business targeting 15% EBITDA margin.
Target to reach ₹5,000 Cr revenue in next three years
Total capex of ₹1,500-1,700 Cr to be completed by September 2027

industry: Industrials > Capital Goods > Industrial Products > Compressors, Pumps & Diesel Engines

operating_notes.text: Received empanelment for 6,580 solar water pumping systems of 3 HP, 5 HP, 7.5 HP from MSEDCL worth ₹142.55 Cr (₹155.24 Cr with GST) executable in 60 days.
Order book ₹1,500 Cr as on 7 May 2026 inclusive of GST.
Solar pumps installed rose 51% YoY in Q4FY26 and 20% YoY in FY26.
Order book of ₹1,500 Cr as on 7 May 2026, of which ₹500 Cr is from Maharashtra.
FY26 solar pump installations 86,086 units (+20% YoY); Q4FY26 28,345 units (+51% YoY).
Q4FY26 solar business executed ₹704 Cr of orders; FY26 solar execution ₹2,080 Cr.
Solar pump volumes increased by 57.6% YoY to 27,678 units in Q1FY27
Rooftop business revenue grew to ₹8 Cr in Q1FY27 from ₹2 Cr in Q1FY26
Export business generates approximately ₹100 Cr in orders per quarter
Shakti EV Mobility Private Limited turnover was ₹24.25 Cr in FY2026, ₹3.73 Cr in FY2025, and ₹4.30 Cr in FY2024, with total assets of ₹128.57 Cr as of 31 March 2026.

timeline.summary: Shakti Pumps invested ₹7 Cr in its subsidiary Shakti Energy Solutions on April 18, 2026, for a 2.20 GW solar module plant in Pithampur.
Shakti Pumps invested ₹10 Cr in its EV subsidiary Shakti EV Mobility on April 21, 2026, taking total investment to ₹65 Cr.
Received Letter of Empanelment from MSEDCL for 6,580 solar pumps worth ₹142.55 Cr (₹155.24 Cr with GST).

Shakti Pumps (India) Limited’s **Ravi Patidar** schedules Q4-FY2026 earnings conference call on **May 11, 2026, at 14:00 IST** for audited results ending **March 31, 2026** with **Dinesh Patidar, Ramesh Patidar, Ramakrishna Sataluri, Dinesh Patel**, and **Ravi Patidar** attending.
Shakti Pumps (India) Limited’s Board recommended ₹1 final dividend per equity share (10%) for FY2026, subject to AGM approval, with record date July 29, 2026.
Shakti Pumps filed Q4FY26 Monitoring Agency Reports showing ₹214.83 crore of unutilised QIP proceeds across two issues.
Shakti Pumps (India) Limited’s **Ravi Patidar** shared the conference call recording for audited Q4FY26 and FY26 results on May 11, 2026, at 14:00 IST via the company’s website.

Shakti Pumps' Q4FY26 earnings call: management guided KUSUM 2.0 orders from Q2FY27, ₹1,500 Cr order book execution over two quarters, and 0.5 GW module plant commissioning by end-Q1FY27, but gave no FY27 revenue or margin guidance.
Dinesh Patidar, as promoter of Shakti Pumps (India) Limited, declared holding 62,135,796 equity shares on March 31, 2026, with no encumbrances.
Q1FY27 earnings call held on 27 July 2026, with revenue growing 37.9% YoY to ₹859 Cr and EBITDA margin stable at 9.6%
Shakti Pumps (India) Limited’s **Ravi Patidar** announced a Q2 & H1 FY27 earnings conference call on **October 26, 2026, at 14:00 IST** for unaudited results.
On 22 October 2026, Shakti Pumps announced an investment of ₹12 Cr in its wholly owned subsidiary Shakti EV Mobility Private Limited, raising total consolidated investment to ₹92 Cr.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹746.03 Cr (+12.0% YoY), net profit ₹38.51 Cr (-57.5% YoY).
Shakti Pumps released its Q2 & H1 FY27 investor presentation highlighting a revenue of ₹746 Cr and an order book of ₹751 Cr.
